title: Baba yeh musalma mujhe rone nahi dete matam
body:
baba yeh musalma mujhe rone nahi dete matam
tera zindaan mein hone nahi dete
1. bistar tera seena tha jisse cheen liya hain
ab god mein madar ke bhi sone nahi dete
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ehsaas-e-yateemi mujhe zindaan me huwa hai
main khaak pe soti hu toh sone nahi dete
<<DIVIDER>>
3. hai aag ke maanind hai sajjad ke zewar
zanjeer juda tan se ye hone nahi dete
<<DIVIDER>>
4. zaalim ke tamachon se lahoo behta hai baba
ashkon se yeh ruksaar bhi dhone nahi dete
<<DIVIDER>>
5. thak jaate hain sajjad toh baba tere khaatil
bimaar mere bhai ko sone nahi dete
<<DIVIDER>>
6. marjaongi zindan ke andhere mein sisak kar
roti hu toh zalim mujhe rone nahi dete
